BREAKING: $DASH 8-K filed Oct 29 — a merger or acquisition: “DoorDash to Acquire Instacart to Help Local Stores Win SAN FRANCISCO, October 29, 2026 -- DoorDash, Inc. (NASDAQ: DASH) and Maplebear Inc. …” How do you read it? #8K #MergersAndAcquisitions

What the filing says
“DoorDash to Acquire Instacart to Help Local Stores Win SAN FRANCISCO, October 29, 2026 -- DoorDash, Inc. (NASDAQ: DASH) and Maplebear Inc. (d.b.a. Instacart, NASDAQ: CART) today announced a definitive agreement under which DoorDash will …
… acquire Instacart for a total value of $65.00 for each Instacart share, or an equity value of approximately $17 billion.”
The filing: 8-K Item 1.01 (entered into a material agreement), filed 2026-10-29.
